scope: The Southern Branch of the National Palace Museum’s main exhibition building and its Zhimei pedestrian bridge in Taibao, as seen on the day after the museum’s December 2015 soft opening.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The museum records a 142 m single steel arch, one-metre southward tilt and 25 changing curved ribs on the S-shaped bridge.
The architect describes the dark solid gallery, glass-and-steel public wing, linking third volume, bamboo courtyard and disk-pattern gallery cladding.
The museum confirms the soft opening on December 28, 2015, and the Gugong Boulevard address.
